name: Name Dialog
description: Asks for one name to rename a Project, Workspace, Tab, or Tab group, or to create a named Project or Tab group, under a title that also labels the field and a caller-declared rule for a blank name.

states: Choose Rename from a Project or Workspace menu, inspect the prefilled and selected current name under a title that also labels the field, then submit or cancel.
Clear the name and submit to see the localized reason with the field focused, then type a name and see the reason go.
Choose New Project… from a Workspace's Move to Project submenu and commit the new Project and that Workspace's membership together.
Use the active Tab shortcut to inspect the prefilled and selected current name with the help that says a blank name restores the terminal's title.
Submit a name, then reopen from the Tab's Rename row, clear, and submit to restore the terminal title.
Choose Add to group, then New group… from a Tab's menu to see the Tab's name suggested for the group with the help that blank leaves it unnamed; rename the group from its own menu.

useWhen: A person renames a Project, a Workspace, a terminal Tab, or a Tab group.
A person creates a Project while moving an existing Workspace into it, or creates a Tab group from Tabs.
avoidWhen: The person is creating an independent Workspace; use the one-click New Workspace action.
The value is not one display name, such as a directory, a command, or more than one field.
invariants: The title names the only field, which takes no second label; the current or suggested name opens prefilled and selected.

The dialog submits the exact text typed. A name longer than 512 characters is always refused, and the caller declares whether a blank name is refused with a reason or accepted with help that says what blank does.
A refused name shows its localized reason on submit or blur, and the reason then follows the field until the name is fixed.
Cancel, Escape, the close button and backdrop dismissal commit nothing, and a Dialog whose target leaves closes with it.
Submitting commits to the target captured when the Dialog opened and never redirects the name to a newly active Tab, group, Project, or Workspace.
A name never changes a directory, launch resources, terminal identity, or Git identity.
